sub_sector.value: Sulfuric acid and regeneration; sulfur dioxide; catalyst activation

manufacturing_type.detail: Regenerates sulfuric acid, produces virgin sulfuric acid and sulfur dioxide derivatives, treats chemical waste, and activates catalysts.

product_complexity.detail: Produces specialty grade high-purity virgin sulfuric acid, ultra-pure sulfur dioxide, and derivatives that meet rigorous quality standards.

production_role.detail: Supplies sulfur chemicals for industrial processes and regenerates spent sulfuric acid for refiners producing alkylate.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves refining and renewable fuels, mining, vehicle batteries, copper for electronics, industrial and municipal water treatment, and agricultural products.

notes: The evidence does not establish whether Ecovyst makes its sulfur products to order or for stock.
